title: With hardship, ease
english: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease.

title: Remember Me
english: So remember Me; I will remember you.

title: Hearts find rest
english: Truly it is in the remembrance of God that hearts find peace.

title: Do not despair
english: Do not despair of God’s mercy.

title: Allah does not burden
arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
english: God does not burden any soul with more than it can bear.

title: He will provide
arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥ
english: Whoever puts his trust in God, He will be enough for him.

title: Do not weaken
english: Do not lose heart or despair.

title: Speak good or silence
arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

title: Love for brother
arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
english: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
